name: Ensnared Divinity
source:
Imprisoned demi-goddess Seraphina must defy her captors in a fantastical world consumed by darkness. With unwavering hope, she faces a skeptical dungeon guard, unyielding in her loyalty to the evil hordes. As their ideologies clash, Seraphina's determination ignites a rebellion, promising an epic tale of light versus darkness and the power of resilience in an extraordinary journey.

[From [url=https://dpstudios.itch.io/ensnared-divinity]Itch.io[/url]]
translation:
在一個被黑暗吞噬的奇幻世界裡，遭到囚禁的半神塞拉菲娜必須反抗俘虜她的人。懷著堅定不移的希望，她面對一名心存懷疑、卻對邪惡大軍忠心不二的地牢女守衛。兩人的信念不斷衝突，塞拉菲娜的決心點燃了反抗的火焰。光明與黑暗的史詩較量，以及堅韌不屈的力量，將在這段非凡旅程中展開。

[摘自[url=https://dpstudios.itch.io/ensnared-divinity]itch.io[/url]]
